data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $110M to date. The valuation universe comprises 8 private companies within the sector (including peers such as Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayave, Zipline, and Joby Aviation), with no direct public comparables available for reference.

Stage-progression analysis applies to this valuation. Using total capital raised of $110M as a baseline proxy and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $209M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient narrowly-filtered comparables; while 7 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet strict same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier criteria, making sector-wide medians unreliably broad for this analysis.

The triangulated valuation range supported by applicable methods is $178M (low) to $240M (high), with a median point of $209M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.9x step-up multiplier for Manna Aero specifically, given the nascent state of comparable exit data in autonomous systems, and the limited visibility into capital efficiency and unit economics relative to peer benchmarks.
